clean_head_proof.result: every one of the 23 files fails with the identical per-file count as the main working tree — 49 FAILED + 11 setup errors, no more, no fewer, no different files
clean_head_proof.conclusion: all tracked-suite failures pre-exist at the T31 base commit; the T31 working tree (src/sciencemath/comparability/, the T31 test files, the recovered raw rows, the README edit) is not their cause
clean_head_proof.representative_root_cause: later authorized remediations changed files pinned by earlier byte-freeze assertions without re-pinning the earlier tests: commit 8caf8d0 (2026-09-27, 'feat: remediate integrated execution for T27') modified src/sciencemath/integrated/runner.py whose sha256 is one of the 244 components of the T26 V3 freeze written by 9fdfe2a (2026-09-26, 'T26: make freeze-bound rehearsal reproducible'); the T26 verification recomputes component hashes from the live repository and now mismatches. The T23 and T27 assertions are the same class: historical freeze identities recomputed against superseded freeze records.
